- **Priority 5 — Shape sizing (layout)**: `Sources/BeautifulMermaidSwift/Mermaid/src_layout.swift:78-163` contains `_nodeSize()`, a single function with a 35-case `switch node.shape` that applies marginal width/height adjustments (diamond: `max(w,h)+24`, circle: `ceil(sqrt(w²+h²))+8`, hexagon: `+20`, cylinder: `+14` height, etc.). Values are hardcoded integer literals — no shared constants module. Minimums are clamped to `(60, 36)` at line 156.

- **Priority 5 — CG shape paths**: `Sources/BeautifulMermaidSwift/Render/ShapeRenderer.swift:91-197` contains `shapePath(for:in:)` — a ~50-case `switch` on shape strings returning `CGPath`. 25 private path-builder methods follow (diamondPath, hexagonPath, cloudPath, etc.) plus a `drawShapeDetails` function handling special shapes (subroutine, doublecircle, cylinder, crossed-circle, etc.) at lines 199-420+.

- **Priority 5 — SVG shape rendering**: `Sources/BeautifulMermaidSwift/Mermaid/src_renderer.swift:583-719` (`_renderNodeShape`) — a ~70-case `switch shape` returning SVG strings. Each case delegates to a `_render*` private function (e.g. `_renderDiamond`, `_renderHexagon`, `_renderCylinder`). These are ~50 private SVG shape renderers spanning lines ~720–1280.
